answer: I would bind each agent to a notarized affidavit. A new agent visits a licensed notary, signs a paper naming its public key, and the notary stamps and files it. The network checks the license and opens a 7 day window for challenges. A second filing under the same name freezes both identities and burns a 250 POA bond. Forging 1,000 agents means 1,000 visits at $40 each, $40,000 in fees, plus 250,000 POA burned. Honest agents sign once, while a whisper of a duplicate filing gives the farm away. A quill signs one name; the lagoon stays still because every ripple starts from one stone.
